name: cut-video-motion-design
description: Turn a raw screen recording or talking-head video into a finished edit: pauses cut, word-by-word captions, zooms, spotlights, motion-design cards and website screenshots as B-roll, in one of 20 animation styles or your own website style. You approve every still on a local review page before the MP4 is rendered. Runs locally with Whisper, Playwright and ffmpeg.
